parts.title: 三、听短文回答问题（4分，每小题1分）

questions.script: Last Sunday, Li Ming went to a computer shop with his father. There were many computers in the shop. The shopkeeper showed them three laptops. Laptop A was the cheapest, but it was slow. Laptop B was faster than Laptop A, but it was heavier. Laptop C was the most expensive, but it was the fastest and the lightest. Li Ming's father said, 'We will take Laptop C. It is the best for your studies.' Q1: When did Li Ming go to the computer shop? Q2: Which laptop was the cheapest? Q3: Which laptop was the fastest? Q4: Which laptop did they buy?
questions.stem: When did Li Ming go to the computer shop?
Which laptop was the cheapest?
Which laptop was the fastest?
Which laptop did they buy?

parts.title: 八、阅读理解二（5分，每小题1分）

questions.passage:
How to Choose a Computer

Many students want a computer, but they don't know how to choose. Here is some advice.

First, think about what you need. If you only do homework, a cheap and small one is enough. If you like games, you need a faster one with a bigger screen.

Second, compare the prices. Don't buy the most expensive one. The best computer is not always the most expensive one.

Third, try it in the shop. Is the keyboard comfortable? Is the screen clear enough?

Remember: the most suitable computer is the best one for you.

假如你是李明，你的朋友 Tom 想买一台电脑，向你请教。请你给他写一封电子邮件，推荐一款电脑并说明理由。内容包括：1. 你推荐哪款电脑；2. 它与其他电脑相比有什么优点（至少使用两处比较级和一处最高级）；3. 你的建议。词数80左右。
questions.hint: 注意电子邮件格式（称呼、正文、落款）；多用本单元学过的比较级和最高级；语句通顺，理由充分。
